import com.google.gson.Gson;
import com.google.gson.GsonBuilder;
import com.google.gson.JsonArray;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import java.io.BufferedWriter;
import java.io.File;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Writes player list files exactly the way net.minecraft.server.players.StoredUserList.save does
 * (GSON = new GsonBuilder().setPrettyPrinting().create(); GSON.toJson(array, GSON.newJsonWriter(writer))),
 * with the field order of NameAndId / ServerOpListEntry / BanListEntry serialisation. Also prints
 * UUID.nameUUIDFromBytes("OfflinePlayer:" + name) reference values.
 */
public class Gen {
  static final Gson GSON = new GsonBuilder().setPrettyPrinting().create();

  static void save(File f, JsonArray a) throws Exception {
    try (BufferedWriter w = Files.newBufferedWriter(f.toPath(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
      GSON.toJson(a, GSON.newJsonWriter(w));
    }
  }

  static JsonObject player(String uuid, String name) {
    JsonObject o = new JsonObject();
    o.addProperty("uuid", uuid);
    o.addProperty("name", name);
    return o;
  }

  static void ban(JsonObject o, String created, String source, String expires, String reason) {
    o.addProperty("created", created);
    o.addProperty("source", source);
    o.addProperty("expires", expires);
    o.addProperty("reason", reason);
  }

  public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
    File dir = new File(args[0]);
    String notch = "069a79f4-44e9-4726-a5be-fca90e38aaf5";
    String jeb = "853c80ef-3c37-49fd-aa49-938b674adae6";
    String griefer = UUID.nameUUIDFromBytes("OfflinePlayer:Griefer".getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)).toString();

    JsonArray wl = new JsonArray();
    wl.add(player(notch, "Notch"));
    wl.add(player(jeb, "jeb_"));
    save(new File(dir, "whitelist.json"), wl);

    JsonArray ops = new JsonArray();
    JsonObject op1 = player(notch, "Notch");
    op1.addProperty("level", 4);
    op1.addProperty("bypassesPlayerLimit", false);
    ops.add(op1);
    JsonObject op2 = player(jeb, "jeb_");
    op2.addProperty("level", 2);
    op2.addProperty("bypassesPlayerLimit", true);
    ops.add(op2);
    save(new File(dir, "ops.json"), ops);

    JsonArray bans = new JsonArray();
    JsonObject b1 = player(griefer, "Griefer");
    ban(b1, "2026-10-12 19:30:00 +0000", "Server", "forever", "Don't grief <spawn> & \"town\" = bad");
    bans.add(b1);
    JsonObject b2 = player(jeb, "jeb_");
    ban(b2, "2026-10-12 21:30:00 +0200", "BlockForge (alice)", "2026-10-19 19:30:00 +0000", "Spam \u2603 line\u2028sep \\ back");
    bans.add(b2);
    save(new File(dir, "banned-players.json"), bans);

    JsonArray ips = new JsonArray();
    JsonObject i1 = new JsonObject();
    i1.addProperty("ip", "203.0.113.7");
    ban(i1, "2026-10-12 19:30:00 +0000", "(Unknown)", "forever", "Banned by an operator.");
    ips.add(i1);
    save(new File(dir, "banned-ips.json"), ips);

    save(new File(dir, "empty.json"), new JsonArray());

    for (String n : new String[] {"Notch", "notch", "Griefer", "a", "_", "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOP", "\u00c4\u00d6\u00dc"}) {
      System.out.println(n + "\t" + UUID.nameUUIDFromBytes(("OfflinePlayer:" + n).getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)));
    }
  }
}
